name: What factors influence the cost of door casing installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the cost of door casing installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost to install door casing depends on the number of openings, linear footage, trim profile, and material selection like MDF versus solid pine or hardwood. Choosing standard pre-primed profiles keeps material costs low, while custom profiles or stained hardwoods require more detailed woodworking and careful handling. Other factors that shape labor costs include whether old casing needs careful removal without damaging surrounding drywall, as well as whether final caulking, hole-filling, and finish painting are included in the carpentry quote.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on the number of doors, wood species versus MDF, custom profile complexity, and whether prep tasks like tear-out, caulking, and finish painting are included.
